title: Vibrant Crisp Spanish Vegetable Gazpacho
description: A refreshing and indulgent Spanish dish featuring sake-cooked vegetables, this gazpacho is a perfect blend of peppery and crisp flavors, made with satvik-friendly ingredients and a tempering technique.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the chopped cucumber, bell pepper, tomato, and red onion.
In a small saucepan, heat the sake over medium heat until it starts to simmer.
Add the minced garlic to the sake and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Remove the garlic and sake mixture from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Add the cooled garlic and sake mixture to the bowl with the vegetables and stir to combine.
In a small skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat until it starts to shimmer.
Add the smoked paprika to the olive oil and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Pour the tempered olive oil mixture over the vegetables and stir to combine.
Season the gazpacho with salt and black pepper to taste.
Chill the gazpacho in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.
